title.zh: 规定宿务省Tuburan市镇一所医院的维护与运营并授权为此拨付所需经费的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Maintenance and Operation of a Hospital in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, and Authorizing the Appropriation of the Necessary Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Maintenance and Operation of a Hospital in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, and Authorizing the Appropriation of the Necessary Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3139_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be, under the direct supervision of the Director of Medical Services, a twenty-five-bed general hospital in the Municipality of Tuburan, Province of Cebu, to be known as the Tuburan Hospital. The site for the said hospital shall be provided by the Municipal Council of the Municipality of Tuburan in consultation with the Director of Medical Services.
The Secretary of Health shall promulgate such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry into effect the purpose of this Act.

The sum of one hundred fifty thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the maintenance and operation of the said hospital for the fiscal year nineteen hundred sixty-two: Provided, That no amount herein authorized to be appropriated will be released unless the Secretary of Health certifies that a suitable hospital building is available. Such sums as may be necessary for its operation and maintenance in subsequent years shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 17, 1961.
